newsitem.title: USA: New Plan Realty issues $20 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: New Plan Realty issues $20 mln in notes.

text.p: New Plan Realty Trust said on Friday it issued $20 million of unsecured senior 30-year notes with a 7.68 percent coupon, in conjunction with its real estate acquisition program.

The notes, issued through Smith Barney Inc and Lehman Brothers, were due November 2, 2026, had no put or call provisions and were non-amortizing. New Plan said this was its third note issue with a 30-year term without puts.
The real estate investment trust said $10 million of the notes were issued through Lehman Brothers and $10 million were issued through Smith Barney. The settlement date was November 1, it said.
